subtitle: Lesson 16 · Workbooks & Visualization

eyebrow: Step one: the question, then the query
code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType != "0"
| summarize FailedCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
caption: ResultType "0" means success, so excluding it isolates failed sign-ins -- then bin by the hour for a trend line.

code:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ResultType != "0"
| where UserPrincipalName == '{TargetUser}'
| summarize FailedCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart
caption: {TargetUser} substitutes the parameter's current value in before the query runs.
